# ClearGlass Inc

> Enterprise cybersecurity, AI automation, autonomous agents, OSINT, digital
> investigations, and software architecture. Founded by Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
> (Software Architect, Founder & Chairman). Based in Burlington, Ontario, Canada;
> serving clients worldwide.

ClearGlass Inc builds zero-trust security platforms, autonomous AI agents,
investigative/OSINT automation, and enterprise workflow systems. The site is the
official home of the Artemis, Guardian, Sentinel, Conduit, and Percival systems.
